title: ǂʼAmkoe language - Wikipedia
text: ǂʼAmkoe / ˈæmkɔɪ / AM-koy, formerly called by the dialectal name ǂHoan (alternatively spelled ǂHȍã, ǂHûân, ǂHua, ǂHû, or in native orthography ǂHȍȁn, and also known as Eastern ǂHoan, to distinguish from Western ǂHoan), is a severely endangered Kxʼa language [2] of Botswana.

title: Kxʼa languages - Wikipedia
text: Historical range of the Kxʼa languages in orange.
